deliverableJust: A web-based simulation allows students to visualize the 'cascading failure' of risks in real-time. It provides immediate feedback on mitigation strategies which is impossible in static paper-based assignments.
problemStatement: In COM0463, students often treat Risk Registers as a bureaucratic chore. They struggle to differentiate between risk 'likelihood' and 'impact' in high-pressure scenarios. Traditional methods fail to demonstrate the 'Chaos Debt' incurred when Tiger-class risks are ignored. Crisis Command gamifies this by putting students in a high-stakes simulation where every decision has a visible cost and a tangible impact on the project survival bar.
inScope: Interactive Risk Dashboard with Chaos Meter
Tusler Classification Card System (Kitten to Tiger)
Resource Allocation Engine (Budget vs Risk Mitigate)

frs.desc: System shall allow players to classify incoming risks into Tusler's four quadrants.
System shall track 'Project Health' and 'Budget' across 10 simulation turns.
System shall trigger random events based on unmitigated risks.
System shall provide a debriefing screen showing the cost of failure for each decision.

nfrs.desc: Turn transitions shall occur in under 500ms.
New users shall be able to complete the tutorial in < 5 minutes.

successCriteria: Target 80% accuracy in risk classification within 3 sessions
Increase in student participation from 45% (static) to 85% (gamified)
Improvement in Bloom L4 (Analysis) assessment scores by 30%

userStories.want: see the probability of a Tiger risk triggering
userStories.benefit: I can prioritize my limited budget effectively

sdtAutonomy: Players choose which risks to mitigate and which to accept (risk appetite).
sdtCompetence: Mastering Tusler's quadrants unlocks advanced mitigation 'Power-ups'.
sdtRelatedness: Global leaderboard allows students to see how they rank against the 'Industry Benchmark'.

mdaAnalysis.mechanics: Risk Cards, Budget Tokens, Chaos Meter, Turn-based Strategy, Event Deck.
mdaAnalysis.dynamics: Risk-taking vs. Caution, Resource Scarcity, Escalation of commitment.
mdaAnalysis.aesthetics: Challenge (Simulation tension), Narrative (War Room atmosphere), Discovery (Learning through failure).

sixDim.what: A turn-based risk management simulator focusing on IT project scenarios.
sixDim.why: To transform abstract PM theory into concrete decision-making skills.
sixDim.who: Engineering students who value technical mastery and competitive ranking.
sixDim.when: Deployed during the 'Risk Management' module of COM0463.
sixDim.how: Web-app accessible via browser; no installation required.
sixDim.where: Used in lab sessions and as a project deliverable.

narrativeArc: From an Entry-level PM to an 'Alligator Wrangler' (Senior Risk Lead).
characters: Major Risk (Instructor/NPC), The Stakeholder (Randomized pressure), The Tech Lead (Advisor).
storyWorld: A high-stakes IT firm managing a national software infrastructure project under tight deadlines.
introText: Welcome to the War Room, PM. A massive database migration is about to begin. The shadows are full of Kittens and Tigers. Save the project, or watch the bars turn red.
preGameSetup: 1. Import student roster. 2. Explain Tusler quadrants. 3. Distribute initial resource tokens.

sessionSteps.activity: Audit the project backlog for hidden risks.
React to 10 rounds of random event triggers.

scenarios.name: The Tiger's Pounce
scenarios.title: Infrastructure Failure
scenarios.objective: Minimize health impact with emergency response.
scenarios.outcome: Win: Risk Maestro Badge; Fail: Chaos Debt incurred

scoringSystem.basis: Points awarded for accurate classification and cost-effective mitigation.
scoringSystem.bonuses: Stealth Mitigation: Prevent a risk without it ever triggering.
scoringSystem.badges: Tiger Tamer, Budget Guardian, Alligator Wrangler.

socialRationale: Competition drives engagement in engineering cohorts.

rewardTiers.elite: Project Hero (Top 5%): Bonus points on COM0463 midterm.
rewardTiers.professional: Senior PM: Digital Badge for LinkedIn.

facilitatorRole: Monitors the leaderboard and triggers a 'Manual Boss Event' if the class is performing too well.

bloomOutcomes.outcome: Evaluate risk probability vs impact effectively.

kirkpatrick.l2: Quiz scores on Risk Management exam questions.
kirkpatrick.l3: Quality of Risk Registers in final projects.
kirkpatrick.l4: Project success rate in subsequent courses.

dataCollection: Logged via the simulation engine events.
